capabilities: Cycle heading folds and the whole-note fold overview
Make V, dd, yy, p and >> act on folded subtrees
Promote and demote headings and list items
Move subtrees, list items, table rows and columns
Indent the note display by outline level
disambiguation: Not an org chart or organization tool; it brings Emacs org-mode outline keys to Obsidian's Vim mode.
extras: The keys need Settings → Editor → Vim key bindings turned on, while the commands and indent mode work without Vim mode. The plugin relies on undocumented Obsidian Vim mode interfaces, so an Obsidian update can stop it.
intentEvidence: Evil Org adds org-mode outline keys to the Vim mode of Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's Vim mode has no org-style fold keys and counts a folded heading as many lines, so V, dd, p and >> act on single lines instead of whole subtrees.

relations.evidence: The keys operate as in the Emacs package evil-org-mode.

summary: Adds org-mode outline keys to Obsidian's Vim mode: Tab/Shift-Tab fold cycling, subtree-aware Vim commands, and heading, list and table moves.
